name: DayZ
tagline: Server mod plus a small sidecar that connect a DayZ dedicated server to Takaro; players install nothing.
requirements: Node.js 22 or Docker on the server host

assets.label: Server mod
assets.hint: Required. Copy @TakaroIntegration into the server folder and add -serverMod=@TakaroIntegration to the server's start line.

assets.label: Sidecar
assets.hint: Required. Run it on the same host as the server with TAKARO_REGISTRATION_TOKEN set; the mod reaches it on 127.0.0.1:8088.
